req.title: Reject wrong method on /post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than POST on /post.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /post must return HTTP 405 for any method other than POST. We need: (1) a positive test confirming POST returns 200, (2) negative tests for each non-POST method (GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD) returning exactly 405, and (3) boundary tests at the method-set boundary (e.g., OPTIONS which is not in the allowed list). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 405 (not >= 400, not 404), and asserting 200 for POST (not just 2xx). We also verify the Allow header contains 'POST' on 405 responses to catch mutations that change the route method list.

tests.name: test_post_method_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send HTTP POST request to /post with no body
expected: Response body is JSON containing keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: POST on /post must succeed with 2xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_method_returns_200():
    r = client.post('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in data

test_post_method_returns_200()

tests.name: test_get_on_post_endpoint_returns_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed (exactly 405, not 404 or 400)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_on_post_endpoint_returns_405():
    r = client.get('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 200

test_get_on_post_endpoint_returns_405()

tests.name: test_options_on_post_endpoint_returns_405_or_200_with_allow_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect Allow header to confirm POST is the only allowed method
expected: Either HTTP 405 or HTTP 200 with Allow header containing POST
Allow header must NOT contain GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: OPTIONS on /post reveals allowed methods; POST must be the only listed method
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_options_on_post_endpoint_allow_header():
    r = client.options('/post')
    allow = r.headers.get('Allow', '')
    if r.status_code == 200:
        assert 'POST' in allow
        assert 'GET' not in allow
        assert 'PUT' not in allow
        assert 'PATCH' not in allow
        assert 'DELETE' not in allow
    else:
        assert r.status_code == 405

test_options_on_post_endpoint_allow_header()

tests.name: test_post_with_json_body_returns_200_and_json_key
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send HTTP POST request to /post with JSON body {"key": "value"}
expected: Response JSON contains 'json' key with value {"key": "value"}
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: POST on /post with JSON body must return 200 and echo json field
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_with_json_body_returns_200_and_json_key():
    payload = json.dumps({"key": "value"})
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        data=payload,
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert data['json'] == {"key": "value"}
    assert data['json'] != {"key": "wrong"}

test_post_with_json_body_returns_200_and_json_key()

tests.name: test_all_non_post_methods_return_exactly_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE requests to /post
expected: All non-POST methods return HTTP 405 exactly
trace: R-HTTPBIN-005: Decision table covering all disallowed methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_non_post_methods_return_exactly_405():
    methods = [
        client.get,
        client.put,
        client.patch,
        client.delete,
    ]
    for method_fn in methods:
        r = method_fn('/post')
        assert r.status_code == 405, (
            f"{method_fn.__name__} on /post returned {r.status_code}, expected 405"
        )
        assert r.status_code != 404
        assert r.status_code != 400
        assert r.status_code != 200
        assert r.status_code != 500

test_all_non_post_methods_return_exactly_405()
